identifier_primary_is_official_domain.name: identifier_primary_is_official_domain
identifier_primary_is_official_domain.value: not "identifier"."primary" or ("identifier"."type" = 'domain' and "identifier"."ownership" = 'official' and "identifier"."brandId" is not null)

status_history_status_domain.name: status_history_status_domain
status_history_status_domain.value: "status_history"."to" in ('certified', 'watch', 'blacklist', 'screening', 'accepted', 'awaiting_reply', 'arbitrating', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'unresolved', 'exposed') and ("status_history"."from" is null or "status_history"."from" in ('certified', 'watch', 'blacklist', 'screening', 'accepted', 'awaiting_reply', 'arbitrating', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'unresolved', 'exposed'))
